edition_title: Keen Africa Opportunities Digest — July 2026 Edition
edition_intro: You are not waiting for a door to open — you are the one who builds them. This July 2026 edition is packed with scholarships to Oxford and Tsinghua, grants up to $1.5M, funded conferences, live hackathons, and certification discounts that expire in weeks. Read it, pick your targets, and apply before the window closes.

posts.title: Rhodes Scholarship for West Africa 2027 (University of Oxford, UK)
posts.summary: One of the world's oldest and most prestigious fully funded postgraduate scholarships, now open for Nigerian applicants to study any subject at Oxford University.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian citizens aged 18–27 (with degree exceptions for medical/law/engineering students), resident in West Africa for at least 5 of the last 10 years, with strong academic record and proven leadership.

posts.title: Schwarzman Scholars 2027–2028 (Tsinghua University, Beijing — Global/US Track)
posts.summary: A fully funded one-year master's degree in Global Affairs at Tsinghua University, purpose-built to develop the next generation of world leaders — open to Nigerians worldwide.
posts.eligibility: Open to all nationalities (except mainland China/HK/Macau/Taiwan applicants); must be 18–28 years old as of 1 August 2027 and hold an undergraduate degree by that date.

posts.title: GREAT Scholarships 2026–27 for Nigerian Students (UK Universities)
posts.summary: The British Council and UK government offer £10,000 toward postgraduate tuition at top UK universities, with active openings specifically for Nigerian applicants across more than a dozen institutions.
posts.deadline: Rolling — varies by university (check individual institution pages)
posts.eligibility: Nigerian nationals applying for a one-year taught postgraduate programme at a participating UK university for the 2026–27 academic year; self-funded applicants only.

posts.title: McCall MacBain Scholarship 2027 at McGill University, Canada (Fully Funded)
posts.summary: Canada's most generous merit scholarship — up to 30 full awards plus finalist prizes — now open to international applicants including Nigerians, with a deadline of 19 August 2026.
posts.eligibility: International applicants (including Nigerians) applying to eligible master's or professional programmes at McGill University for Fall 2027; must demonstrate academic excellence, community leadership, and character.

posts.title: ECOWAS Youth Entrepreneurship Programme (EYEP) 2026 — Up to $15,000 for West African Founders
posts.summary: ECOWAS is offering grants up to $15,000 plus mentorship, technical assistance, and regional visibility to young entrepreneurs with existing businesses across seven West African states, including Nigeria.
posts.eligibility: Young entrepreneurs who are nationals or legal residents of participating ECOWAS member states (including Nigeria) with an existing, operational business — not for idea-stage founders.

posts.title: IFC SME Growth Accelerator 2026 — Up to $1.5 Million for African SMEs
posts.summary: The World Bank Group's IFC is offering $50,000–$1.5 million in grant funding plus mentorship and follow-on financing access to high-potential SMEs operating across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
posts.eligibility: For-profit SMEs with 10–250 employees and verified annual revenue between $250,000 and $10 million, operational in Africa (among other eligible regions); no application fee.

posts.title: MEST AI Startup Program — Class of 2027 (Fully Sponsored, Up to $100,000 Pre-Seed)
posts.summary: MEST Africa's fully sponsored 12-month residential AI entrepreneurship programme in Accra offers Nigerian founders world-class training, incubation, flights, healthcare — and up to $100,000 in pre-seed investment for standout ventures.
posts.eligibility: West and East African nationals aged 21–35 with software development experience and entrepreneurial interest; interviews held in Ghana, Nigeria, Senegal, and Kenya; full-time commitment for up to 12 months required.

posts.title: Africa-Europe Youth Academy (AEYA) New Leaders Lab 2026 — Funded Leadership Programme
posts.summary: A fully funded leadership programme for ambitious young Africans aged 18–30, combining entrepreneurial training, mentorship, and cross-continental networking between Africa and Europe.
posts.eligibility: Young people aged 18–30 from 19 eligible African countries (including Nigeria); demonstrated leadership interest and entrepreneurial mindset required.

posts.title: UNDP African Youth Co-Creators Council 2026 — 11 Funded Seats for Young African Leaders
posts.summary: UNDP is selecting 11 young leaders from across Africa and the diaspora to serve on its African Youth Co-Creators Council, advising on UNDP policy and programming with full funding.
posts.eligibility: Young Africans and diaspora members with a demonstrated record of leadership, innovation, or community impact; open continent-wide including Nigerian nationals.

posts.title: DevCareer × Nomba Hackathon 2026 — $6,500 Prize Pool for Nigerian Developers
posts.summary: A fully virtual 5-week payments hackathon for Nigerian developer teams, offering $4,000 to the winning team and a pathway into Nomba's Developer Partner Programme — open now.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian developer teams (developers, designers, and product builders); fully virtual, open to participants from any part of Nigeria; no application fee.

posts.title: GoGettaz Agripreneur Prize Competition 2026 — Cash Prizes for Young African Agri-Innovators
posts.summary: A prestigious pan-African prize celebrating young agripreneurs innovating across the food and agribusiness value chain, with meaningful cash prizes and global visibility for finalists.
posts.eligibility: Young African entrepreneurs (typically aged 18–35) building innovative, impactful solutions across agriculture and food systems; open to founders across Africa including Nigerians.

posts.title: Accelerate Africa Startup Programme 2026 — Up to $500,000 Investment for Early-Stage Founders
posts.summary: A continent-wide programme supporting early-stage African founders with expert mentorship, structured business development, and potential investment of up to $500,000 from the Future Africa fund.
posts.eligibility: Early-stage founders building globally impactful ventures across Africa; open to entrepreneurs from all African countries including Nigeria.

posts.title: AWS AI Practitioner + Cloud Practitioner Dual Certification — 50% Off + Free Exam (Promo Code: AIF2CLOUD)
posts.summary: AWS and Pearson VUE are offering 50% off the AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam through 30 September 2026, with a free AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam bundled if you pass — two globally recognised certifications for under $60.
posts.eligibility: Open to all individuals aged 18 and above globally; no technical background required for either exam; must book through Pearson VUE using the promo code AIF2CLOUD.

posts.title: Microsoft Virtual Training Days — Free 50% Exam Discount Vouchers for Azure, AI & Security Certifications
posts.summary: Microsoft runs free, instructor-led virtual training events throughout 2026 that award 50% discount vouchers for AZ-900, AI-900, SC-900, and select associate-level Microsoft certification exams.
posts.eligibility: Open globally to anyone; free registration required; must attend the live sessions to qualify for the exam discount voucher.

posts.title: ALX Africa — Subsidised Tech & AI Programmes via Mastercard Foundation Partnership ($5/month Access)
posts.summary: ALX Africa, powered by a Mastercard Foundation partnership, gives eligible African learners access to world-class tech training in Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, Cloud Computing, and more — at $5/month instead of thousands.
posts.deadline: Rolling — applications open year-round with cohort intakes in January, April/May, August, and November
posts.eligibility: African nationals (including Nigerians) who meet programme eligibility requirements; sponsored places are available for qualifying learners through the Mastercard Foundation partnership; Lagos hub available.
